purpose: Track the concrete evidence still required to move Human Infra from value narrative, research framework and toy quantitative model toward a 100% research system.
completionRule: The project is not 100% until every axis reaches 100 and every gate has status pass with direct evidence.
globalBoundaries: Do not mark value clarity complete only because the README is persuasive.
Do not mark research framework complete until strong claims across core domains have Source Cards, Claim-Evidence Matrix rows, variables, falsifiers and model positions.
Do not mark quantitative model complete until real governed data, field confirmation, extraction, survey design, external validation and calibration evidence exist.
Do not output individual death dates, individual life expectancy claims, individual medical advice, or unvalidated calibration claims.

axes.definitionOfDone: Different audiences can understand Human Infra through one stable first-principles thesis, with audience-specific entry points that all preserve scope, evidence and prohibited-use boundaries.

gates.requirement: A stable first-principles thesis exists and is visible from the README.
gates.nextAction: Keep future pages aligned to HI-CL1 through HI-CL3 instead of inventing new top-level slogans.

gates.requirement: The value story supports multiple lenses: subject continuity, universal resource budget and anti-scarcity engineering.
gates.nextAction: Use the lenses as projections of the same thesis, not separate competing missions.

gates.requirement: Different audiences have dedicated entry paths without changing the core thesis.
gates.nextAction: Keep audience-specific entry paths aligned through make audience-claim-map-audit when public narrative pages change.

gates.requirement: The project is clearly distinguished from health management, longevity knowledge bases, AI tools, policy encyclopedias and medical advice systems.
gates.nextAction: Maintain adjacent-project boundary rows when new audience types or public pages are added.

gates.requirement: The value language is constrained by external method anchors and prohibited-use boundaries.
gates.nextAction: Keep method anchors as constraints, not as proof of any specific intervention.

gates.requirement: README, Web homepage, paper pages and major reference documents use one consistent value grammar and claim boundary.
gates.nextAction: Keep major pages aligned through make page-claim-audit before broadening the audit into audience-specific pages.

axes.definitionOfDone: Every strong project claim can be traced to source cards, claim-evidence rows, variables, mechanism links, falsifiers, model position and governance boundary.

gates.requirement: Research domains are physically organized under C1-C6 with README and AGENTS boundaries.
gates.nextAction: Continue using classification.tsv as the path truth source.

gates.requirement: Core Human Infra claims are registered with source anchors, evidence roles and prohibited-use boundaries.
gates.nextAction: Use HI-CL IDs as the project-level claim spine.

gates.requirement: C1 and C2 core research domains have Source Cards, mechanism variables, evidence grade and falsifier rows.
missingEvidence: C2-LT-B7 promotion queue now selects 12 cancer-control, survivorship, transplant-safety, organ-donation and bioengineered organ-replacement domains with 24 web-checked candidate sources, but it is only a source-specific deep-read entrance.

C2-LT-B6 reviewed artifacts promote 24 eligible fresh-review rows into 144 bounded Source/variable/endpoint/uncertainty/transfer/downgrade artifacts while preserving 12 manual blocked/context-only rows.
Remaining C2 long-tail domains outside B1/B2/B3/B4/B5/B6/B7 still need batch selection, source extraction, local review, source-resolution as needed, fresh review and reviewed artifacts.
Reviewed artifacts remain bounded research artifacts and do not open calibrated model admission.
Calibrated model admission still needs narrow quantitative estimands, validation data and L4 gates.
gates.nextAction: Derive C2-LT-B7 into source-extraction tasks, then continue remaining C2 long-tail coverage while keeping all reviewed artifacts bounded and model admission blocked.

gates.requirement: Claims that affect quantitative reasoning define input variables, mediators, state variables, risk variables and outputs.
missingEvidence: C2-LT-B7 promotion queue defines only preliminary variable seeds for 12 cancer-control, survivorship, transplant-safety, organ-donation and organ-replacement domains; no B7 row is admitted as a calibrated model variable.
B6 reviewed artifacts define bounded variable, endpoint, uncertainty, transfer-boundary and downgrade artifacts for 24 eligible rows, but no B6 row is admitted as a calibrated model variable.
B1/B2/B3/B4/B5/B6 reviewed artifacts are governed by the model-admission contract and candidate registry boundaries, but no row is admitted above L1/L2.
Remaining C2 long-tail domains outside B1/B2/B3/B4/B5/B6/B7 still need reviewed variable, endpoint, uncertainty, transfer-boundary and downgrade artifacts.
gates.nextAction: Turn C2-LT-B7 candidate sources into source-extraction rows and keep all B7 variable seeds out of calibrated model use until source review and model-admission gates pass.

gates.requirement: Major routes expose technical window, access, adoption, duration, composability, tail risk and opportunity cost gates.
gates.nextAction: Maintain route-card audit coverage when new high-priority future-boundary routes are added.

gates.requirement: Every strong claim has at least one falsifier or downgrade condition.
missingEvidence: C2-LT-B7 promotion queue requires downgrade-check artifacts for each queued oncology/transplant source path, but no source-specific downgrade extraction or fresh review has been completed yet.
C2-LT-B6 reviewed artifacts include bounded downgrade/falsifier-related artifacts for 24 eligible rows and preserve 12 manual blocked/context-only rows.
Remaining C2 long-tail domains outside B1/B2/B3/B4/B5/B6/B7 still require source-specific downgrade and falsifier coverage.
All B7 rows remain candidate-source routing only; no row opens model-admitted evidence.
Calibrated model downgrade gates still require a separate quantitative model contract and validation plan.
gates.nextAction: Carry B7 candidate sources into source extraction with explicit downgrade triggers, then keep model admission blocked until reviewed artifacts and quantitative gates exist.

axes.definitionOfDone: A governed, reproducible, scenario-level model uses real approved data with confirmed variables, explicit estimands, survey design, disclosure control, validation, calibration diagnostics and Web visualization while preserving no-individual-prediction boundaries.

gates.requirement: Versioned synthetic inputs generate Web model data and a local audit report.
gates.nextAction: Keep the toy model as a reporting contract, not as real prediction evidence.

gates.requirement: Synthetic one-factor sensitivity analysis exists and is audited.
gates.nextAction: Treat this as stress testing only until real calibrated parameter uncertainty exists.

gates.requirement: A public aggregate mortality baseline anchor exists for toy baseline plausibility comparison without individual data or calibration claims.
gates.nextAction: Use the NCHS public aggregate life-table anchor only for baseline plausibility checks; do not treat it as cohort calibration or intervention evidence.

gates.requirement: A machine-readable model-admission contract separates reviewed artifacts, candidate variables, synthetic toy inputs, aggregate calibrated models and blocked individual decision support.
gates.nextAction: Use this contract to build a model-admission candidate registry; do not open calibrated model admission until real data access, exact field confirmation, extraction, weighting, validation and calibration gates pass.

gates.requirement: A machine-readable model-admission candidate registry maps reviewed artifact registers, synthetic L3 artifacts and blocked L4 candidates to explicit admission decisions.
gates.nextAction: Use the registry as a blocking control surface; do not promote any L1/L2 reviewed artifact into L4 until governed data access, exact fields, extraction, weighting, validation and calibration gates pass.

gates.requirement: Real governed cohort data access is approved and documented before extraction.
missingEvidence: Acquisition-readiness validator now proves all 10 readiness gates still block extraction, with storage-destruction-plan upgraded only to partial.
Controlled storage/destruction plan now exists, is machine-validated and has a synthetic create-hash-delete drill, but the real governed plan has not been executed.
NHATS registration evidence.
Allowed file tier confirmation.
Controlled workspace provisioning, access log, inventory log and governed workspace destruction evidence.
gates.nextAction: Complete governed data access records, provision a controlled workspace and execute the real storage/destruction plan outside the public repository before any extractor is written.

gates.requirement: Exact fields, value labels, question text, skip logic, missing codes and route-value crosswalks are confirmed from official sources.
missingEvidence: Controlled Colectica login/access record.
Colectica variable page captures with source hashes.
Authenticated capture template slots are still unfilled.
Confirmed value labels, question text, universe and skip logic.
Confirmed route-value crosswalk with raw values and labels.
Variable-specific negative missing-code map.
Second reviewer signoff.
gates.nextAction: Use the verified access-route workflow and authenticated capture template to complete controlled Colectica login, capture variable pages with hashes, confirm labels/question text/skip logic and keep route classifier blocked until second-reviewer signoff.

gates.requirement: A reproducible extractor creates governed aggregate cohort-flow inputs without leaking raw rows or sensitive fields.
missingEvidence: Pre-outcome aggregation rules exist, but real extraction/cohort-flow table is absent.
Real extraction script.
Governed run log.
Aggregate cohort-flow table.
Disclosure-reviewed output envelope.
gates.nextAction: Use the pre-outcome aggregation protocol as the extractor boundary after data access and field confirmation gates pass; do not aggregate real NHATS rows until cohort-flow and disclosure gates are satisfied.

gates.requirement: Analysis weights, strata, PSU/variance unit, variance method, domain rule and disclosure control are confirmed before weighted estimates.
missingEvidence: Exact NHATS design variables.
Weighted estimator implementation.
Variance method validation.
Public-output suppression review.
gates.nextAction: Promote survey design from synthetic validator to real design-plan validation after field confirmation.

gates.requirement: Model outputs are externally validated and calibrated against real outcomes within a pre-registered scope.
missingEvidence: L2 variable-family mapping now exists, but exact fields, value labels and real extracts are still absent.
Pre-outcome aggregation rules now exist, but they are protocol-only and cannot feed calibration.
Real training/validation split or external cohort.
Calibration diagnostics.
Sensitivity analysis based on real parameter uncertainty.
TRIPOD+AI / PROBAST-style reporting packet.
gates.nextAction: Use the L2 variable-family admission register and pre-outcome aggregation protocol only as pre-admission maps; do not claim prediction validity until real-data calibration and external validation exist.

gates.requirement: The current pipeline blocks individual death dates, individual life predictions and personal medical advice.
gates.nextAction: Keep this boundary even after real aggregate data enters the system.

nextWorkOrder.item: Use the verified NHATS Colectica access-route workflow and authenticated capture template to complete controlled login, fill capture slots with page hashes, confirm value labels/question text/universe/skip logic and fill route-value crosswalk plus variable-specific missing-code map.
Use the frozen NHATS pre-outcome aggregation protocol to fill exact Colectica evidence and real cohort-flow/survey-design aggregation only after MODEL-G3 through MODEL-G6 pass.
Continue C2 long-tail coverage outside B1/B2/B3/B4/B5/B6 and keep all B6 reviewed artifacts bounded until model-admission gates and calibrated validation exist.
